newsitem.title: FRANCE: Small French cos prefer lower social charges - poll.
newsitem.headline: Small French cos prefer lower social charges - poll.

text.p: A majority of leaders of small French businesses would prefer a cut in social charges weighing on their companies to a cut in corporate income tax, a poll shows.
The Ifop survey for French accountants organisation Conseil Superieur de l'Ordre des Experts-Comptables is due for publication by French financial daily Les Echos on Monday.
The poll found that 64 percent of business leaders would choose lower social charges over lower corporate income tax, if given the choice.
Some 90 percent of those polled approved of a recent government decision to cut corporate income tax rate to 19 percent from 33.33 percent for small companies that invest profit in their company.
The poll also showed that only 60 percent of business leaders surveyed were aware of measures parliament voted last year to ease the costs of corporate transmission rights.
The survey was taken January 2 and 7 with 404 individuals heading companies with at least 10 employees.
